title: 1stDibs
description: MCP server for browsing and searching items on 1stDibs marketplace.
summary: MCP server for browsing and searching items on 1stDibs marketplace.
offersHint: MCP server for browsing and searching items on 1stDibs marketplace. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.1stdibs.com/soa/mcp/

toolsPreview.name: read_taxonomy
toolsPreview.description:
Discover how items on 1stDibs are categorized. We have a taxonomy with 
        furniture, art, jewelry, and fashion categories at the top level. 
        This will return a list of next level categories as well as facets with their appropriate filters. 
        You need to specify a category.

toolsPreview.name: browse_items
toolsPreview.description:
Browse 1stDibs with the given category and optional page number and filters. 
        Filters are in the format of a query string like category=furniture&location=usa-north-america. 
        Read the taxonomy to discover facets and filters.

toolsPreview.name: search_items
toolsPreview.description:
Search 1stDibs with the given query and optional page number and filters. 
        Filters are in the format of a query string like category=furniture&location=usa-north-america. 
        Read the taxonomy to discover categories, facets and filters.

toolsPreview.name: item_details
toolsPreview.description:
Get details on a specific item on 1stDibs. You'll need to input the item ID. 
        You can search for an item or browse for an item to find an item ID.
